notes.title: Patch notes 1.03 "MTX Be Gone"
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35486730/2b5e0d7f883511f930dc8a31f01c0289c93a96ae.png

Hey peeps! 
We have listened to your feedback and made some major changes to both the Free & Deluxe Edition of Block Busters.

Major Changes
 All cosmetics are now included in the Deluxe Edition of the game.
 Faster Gameplay (Increased Movement Speed, increased Dash Speed, Cooldowns have been lowered).
 Microtransactions (MTX) have been completely removed!
 In-Game currency rewards have been greatly increased when playing in competitive mode!
 The Level Editor has now been included in the Free version of the game!

Minor Changes
 Fix character names being cut off in local character select screen.
 Fix some hit and trail effects being invisible in the local character select screen. 


Stay safe, friends. Be sure to wash your hands.

Much love, 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35486730/9bdc1464176907e0c9cc34f43d6ebce5f32c3a38.png

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
Good Morning!
Thanks to everyone who joined us during yesterdays play session, it was a lot of fun.

Rolling out a small patch today to increase the quality for the people who have supported us by buying the Deluxe Edition of the game.
Since it can be difficult finding matches online, which is needed to earn Brixx to spend in the shop we decided to include a lot more content in the Deluxe Edition for those who play local with your friends.

Unlocked in the Deluxe Edition
- 5 characters (Mike Dyson, Rubiks, Chester, Booty, Burger)
- 5 hats (Tophat, Partyhat, Cat ears, Pink poop, Gearhat)
- 5 hit and trail effects (Smoke, Glitter, Mystic, Shredded Cheese, Rock)

Added to both editions
- More than 300% increase of Brixx in the Brixx packs

Thank you everyone!

notes.title: Event, Saturday 15th of February 7-9 PM CET & Small Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We will be hosting an event on Saturday the 15th of February, It will run from 7 PM to 9 PM CET.

All of the developers will be online playing the game with you! We will be playing the competitive mode and by the end of the session we will give away 6 codes to the deluxe edition of the game to the top 6 players on the leader-board by the end of the event. 
If you want to get a head-start that's fine, the leader-board will not be reset before the event. I hope you will join us and have some block busting fun!

We've also pushed a small update with a few fixes.

__Change Log__

- Fixed a viewing problem in the leader-board, it will now display your username in the middle of 9 other entries correctly.

- Added more characters to the font, to support more languages for usernames.

- Lowered all the cosmetic prices 25%


We hope to see a lot of you on Saturday!
Much love,
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35486730/9bdc1464176907e0c9cc34f43d6ebce5f32c3a38.png
